headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Marcus Semien leading the offense. Semien hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Yohan Ramírez pitched 3.1 scoreless innings in relief. In other news, the Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, with Josh Smith collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 1 run. The New York Yankees also secured a narrow win, defeating the Atlanta Braves 3-2.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners have also placed RHP Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have placed RHP Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade. Berry joins the Royals after being previously affiliated with another team.
